title: Bridle run-log event
description: One line of a logs/run-<run_id>.jsonl file. Append-only. Every event is stamped with the run and the harness version that governed it.

run_id.description: Identity of the run, e.g. scrape-20260720T101500Z-a1b2c3

harness_version.description: Version field of the HARNESS file governing this run

harness_hash.description: SHA-256 of the HARNESS file content at run start, so edits mid-run are detectable

agent_id.description: Which agent/model executed the step, e.g. claude-sonnet-5

phase.description: Which phase of the run loop this event belongs to

detail.description: Event-class-specific fields, per the Trace Contract table

prompt_file.description: prompts/*.md file this step executes, if any

verdict.description: Only on run_end: did the run meet the Charter's definition of a good run

harness_hash_at_start.description: the harness hash recorded at run start, present only when the file changed mid-run
